task_description: Tell me how many files can be executed directly no matter where my work dir is.

args.script: echo $PATH | tr ':' '\n' | while read dir; do if [ -d "$dir" ]; then find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable 2>/dev/null; fi; done | wc -l
